name: scienceqa
title: ScienceQA — multiple-choice science questions with worked explanations
description: 4,241 multiple-choice science questions (the source's `test` split, out of 12,726 train + 4,241 validation + 4,241 test), spanning natural, social and language science across grades 1-12, each with its choices, the correct answer, a hint, the lecture text it is drawn from, and a worked solution. 2,017 of the 4,241 also ship with a figure in the source; this Protocol keeps only whether one was present (`has_image`), not the picture itself. NON-COMMERCIAL RESTRICTION: the licensor (Pan Lu et al., NeurIPS 2022) publishes ScienceQA under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike), stated on the project site, the source repository and the mirror's own dataset-card body — not its YAML licence tag, which reads plain CC BY-SA and disagrees with its own card. Referencing this dataset's URL and building it locally is not redistribution and is not restricted; using the OUTPUT commercially is. No chart, figure or number built from this Protocol's output may appear on the Meridian site, in launch material, or on a pricing page. Demo data: referenced by pinned URL and revision and built locally. Meridian does not host, publish or redistribute this dataset.

sources.title: derek-thomas/ScienceQA on Hugging Face, revision f18b0a70 (test split)
ScienceQA — Lu et al., "Learn to Explain: Multimodal Reasoning via Thought Chains for Science Question Answering", NeurIPS 2022 (licensor)

answer_choices.description: The 2 to 5 answer options the source offers, joined with ' | ' — the source's `choices` array flattened to a single delimited string.

answer_index.description: 0-based index into the pipe-delimited answer_choices identifying the correct option, as the source records it. Meaningless on its own without answer_choices or answer_text.

answer_text.description: The text of the correct choice, joined from the source's `choices[answer]` so a reader does not have to re-parse answer_choices to learn it.

hint.description: A short context hint the source provides for the question, empty where none is given.

task.description: The question format the source assigns, e.g. closed choice.

grade.description: Grade level the question targets, e.g. grade5.

subject.description: Top-level subject: natural science, social science or language science.

category.description: Finer-grained topic label than subject/topic, e.g. Literary devices.

skill.description: The specific skill the question exercises, as the source names it.

lecture.description: Background teaching text the question draws on, empty where the source gives none.

solution.description: Worked explanation of the correct answer, empty where the source gives none.

has_image.description: Whether the source shipped a figure with this question — true for 2,017 of these 4,241 rows. The image bytes themselves are not carried into this export; see arcform.yaml for why.
